name: app-check
description: app books check (seed 5, the whole dish lit, 240 s): add-cell placements (50, then 200 cells), pipette drops of every substance, zoom and pan, the new culture dialog started in place (colonies, a few types), N, G, a snapshot saved and loaded; atoms and charge rounding must stay 0

evals.js: return await moire.app.place(Array.from({length: 50}, (_, k) => [150 + 13 * k, 120]), moire.genome.founders[1])

const r = []; moire.matter.SUBSTANCES.forEach((s, c) => { if (!s.excited) r.push(moire.matter.addSpring(120 + 60 * (r.length % 8), 650 + 50 * Math.floor(r.length / 8), 'drop:' + s.name, 1.5, {drop: true, rate: 40})); }); return r

moire.camera.fit(); moire.app.openCulture(); document.querySelector('#culture [data-spread=colonies]').click(); document.querySelector('#culture [data-div=few]').click(); const t = document.querySelector('#culture .go').textContent; document.querySelector('#culture .go').click(); return t
return await moire.app.place(Array.from({length: 200}, () => [100 + Math.random() * 1080, 100 + Math.random() * 600]), moire.genome.founders[2])
const s = await moire.snapshot(); const r = await moire.loadSnapshot(s); return {exact: r.exact, cells: r.cells}
